summary: The user set a realtime test on Altair Crossing, a map new to us: our one Armada seat beside his near-idle base, against two BARb medium. He typed 'defend me', then 'Your goal is to win the 1v2'. The first six Pawns reached the Armada lab at H5 at 2:40 and walked back. Next the player built a third lab and three nano turrets on wind power and held the Pawns at passage_1 until there were fifteen; the energy store was empty from 3:54 to about 5:20 while 1,000+ metal sat banked. The fifteen went along the north edge into the Cortex corner and lost 8 Pawns at G2 to Levelers and an LLT (5:26-5:40), killing only an extractor, a constructor and a raider; meanwhile both opponents' Maces, Rocketeers, Pawns and Levelers came into our middle and north. Extractors fell from 10 (5:32) to 3 (9:17), metal stayed at 0 from 6:00, the first lab died at 9:26, and 5 Levelers beat 16 Maces and the commander at B4 at 10:07. The session ended at about 11:04; by then the user's own Banshees had killed the Armada's metal makers at H5-H6.

root.what: The first handful had reached the Armada lab at 2:40, the bank stood at 1,400 and income was 12 a second. The player chose build-up over pressure: a third lab (3:20; the second was started at 2:35) and three nano turrets (3:08), all on wind power while the wind fell from 27 to 15. At 3:37 it also recalled the Pawns to passage_1 to wait for fifteen. The energy store emptied at 3:54, so the fifteen were not ready until 4:31, and no enemy building died to us before 5:35. This is the reader's reading; the clocks come from the tools.

Its Levelers broke the Pawn raid at G2 (5:26-5:40), joined the Armada Maces at D2-D3 at 6:44, and five of them beat 16 Maces at B4 at 10:07. He added an air plant by 6:00, and his Banshees killed the Armada's LLT, radar, extractors, wind turbines and 8 metal makers at G7-H6 between 8:57 and 10:22.

tools: direct reads of record-2.jsonl, bot.log, strategist-2.jsonl, script.txt
lens.caveats: The record is record-2.jsonl (seat ai 2), not record-0. wake_read.py hard-codes strategist-0/record-0, so it, hands_window.py and impedance_sweep.py ran on a scratch folder that aliases the seat-2 files as seat 0. There is no truth file: every enemy number is what we saw. minutes.py and analyze_match.py merge the two BARb into one 'his', and analyze_match's engagement #10 (G8) is the partner's Banshees, not us. pro_baseline.py was not run (not Comet Catcher; no pool for this map). There is no ledger row, no review, and no person's reading beyond the user's two opening lines, so every cause here is the reader's reading. Opponents were BARb medium, not a person.

open_questions: Why did six Pawns walk back from the Armada lab at 2:40-2:42 against 3 Pawns? It could be the packet's outweigh clause, fire from the BARb commander, or the lab's defence; with no truth file it cannot be told.

The user's first instruction was 'defend me', then 'Your goal is to win the 1v2'. No unit of ours was ever stationed toward his base at A7, and enemies stood at B7 at 11:04. Did he mean defence to stay part of the task?
Did the user close the game at 11:04 because he judged it lost? No chat line says so, and no result row exists.
Was the wind-only energy plan a map-specific error (the wind range on Altair is 12 to 27), or would the same three labs and nanos have stalled on solars too?
